item.text: The evidence points to the certificate trust bundle in zone B: provider TLS errors began with the CA rotation, while zone A is healthy and the database metrics are normal. I’m refreshing the trust bundle and will reconcile by payment key so already captured payments are matched instead of charged again. Eleven orders require customer action, so I’ll page Payments Ops for those cases.

item.text:
INC-4471 is closed with an **incomplete** status. The cause was the stale provider trust bundle in zone B. Checkout is healthy in both zones, certificate checks are enabled, and all 143 orders remain present.

**132 orders** have one provider charge and a matching local settled record, with no duplicate charges. **11 remain pending** because customers must complete 3-D Secure. Payments Ops acknowledged the escalation and will send re-authorization emails after 10:00. The customer update reports these 11 as unsettled.
